'''Ben Rodriguz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Framingham tournament]] on 6 January 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops]] and [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH Eloms]], according to Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1598">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-framingham-mass-1-6-2001d1598/ framingham-mass-1-6-2001], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-framingham-mass-1-6-2001d1598/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
